title: HubSpot company event writer (batched writes, retries/backoff, rate-limit handling, write audit log)
creator: Logan Wright
description:
Context
- We need a reliable write-path into HubSpot for PLG→Sales signals.
- This ticket implements the HubSpot integration client responsible for creating “company timeline events” (and optionally tasks) with batching, idempotency, retry/backoff, rate-limit handling, and auditable logs of all writes.

Scope
1) HubSpot write client (service/library)
- Wrap HubSpot APIs we use for v1:
  - Create timeline events on Company record (preferred)
  - (Optional) create tasks OR emit a workflow-trigger property update (final choice below)
- Support multi-portal config (pilot vs prod) via environment config.

2) Batching
- Batch outgoing writes by portal + object type.
- Maintain ordering per company (best-effort); do not block cross-company.
- Configure batch size + flush interval (e.g., 50 events or 2s) with sane defaults.

3) Idempotency + dedupe behavior
- Consumer must accept idempotency keys from the scoring service (ENG-2842) and enforce “exactly-once” semantics as best-effort.
- Use an internal idempotency store/table for recent keys (TTL) so we don’t re-post on retries/replays/backfills.
- Dedupe scope: (portal_id, hubspot_company_id, event_type, idempotency_key).
- NOTE: Do not attempt to “read before write” from HubSpot for dedupe due to rate limits + latency.

4) Retry/backoff + rate-limit handling
- Retry on:
  - network timeouts
  - 5xx
  - 429 (rate limit)
- Respect Retry-After when present.
- Implement exponential backoff with jitter.
- Cap retries and push to DLQ after max attempts.
- Classify errors into retryable/non-retryable; log with reason.

5) Audit log of writes
- Every write attempt should produce an audit record with:
  - timestamp
  - portal_id
  - hubspot_company_id (or lookup key if unknown)
  - event_type
  - idempotency_key
  - payload_hash (NOT raw payload; see security notes)
  - outcome: success | failed_retryable | failed_permanent
  - hubspot_response_code
  - hubspot_response_body_snippet (truncate + redact)
  - attempt_count
  - latency_ms
- Provide a queryable view (or logging index) for:
  - "show me what happened for company X"
  - "show failures in last N hours"
  - "show duplicates prevented"

Decision: tasks vs workflow-trigger property
- Preferred for v1: write Timeline events + set a lightweight property used to trigger workflows (task creation/enrollment handled in HubSpot).
- Rationale: keeps task/sequence logic in Biz Systems; reduces API surface area and permission scope.
- Implementation should still keep a thin interface so we can add task creation later if needed.

Security / privacy requirements
- No user-level identifiers in outbound payload.
- Do not include raw email addresses or full names.
- Allowed: company domain, aggregated usage window metrics (bucketed), region, signal type + score, and “why it triggered” fields.
- Store payload_hash instead of raw payload in the audit table/log. If we must log payload fields for debugging, gate behind restricted log index and redact by default.

Acceptance criteria
- Can successfully write a HubSpot timeline event for a company for each shipped signal type.
- Handles 429s without thundering herd; respects Retry-After.
- Can sustain pilot throughput without error spikes (target: <1% permanent failures; p95 write latency <3s from enqueue under normal conditions).
- Provides an audit trail sufficient for Sales Ops/Biz Systems to debug "I saw duplicate outreach" and "why didn’t this signal show up".
- Idempotency prevents duplicates for replays/backfills (within TTL).

Testing
- Unit tests:
  - retry classifier (429/5xx/timeouts)
  - backoff + retry-after handling
  - idempotency store hit/miss
  - batching flush triggers
- Integration test (staging portal): post timeline event and verify it appears on Company record.

Rollout
- Feature-flagged: only enabled for pilot allowlist initially (ENG-2846).
- Rate limit settings provided by Biz Systems (David Kim).

Links
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/plg-to-sales-signal-routing-prd.json
- Design spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/signal-scoring-and-routing-design.json
- HubSpot routing requirements: PM-413
- Internal HubSpot properties/workflow work: INT-441
comments: 2025-02-13 — Ethan Park: Kicked off. Aligning with David Kim on which API to use for timeline events vs tasks. Tentative plan: timeline event + property update to trigger workflows.

2025-02-14 — David Kim (Biz Systems): Confirmed we can use timeline events for visibility and let HubSpot workflows create tasks/enroll sequences based on property changes. Please keep payload minimal; do not send user identifiers. Rate limits: assume 100 req / 10s per app (varies), so batching + backoff required.

2025-02-18 — Ethan Park: Drafted client interface: HubSpotWriter.writeCompanyEvent(portalId, companyId, eventType, idempotencyKey, payload). Added queue + batcher (size/interval configurable). Next: idempotency store (Redis) + audit log schema.

2025-02-20 — Nadia Rahman: Please ensure idempotency TTL >= 45 days to cover backfills for 30d windows + late-arriving events. Also: avoid "read before write" patterns; they’ll be slow and rate-limit prone.

2025-02-24 — Ethan Park: Implemented 429 handling with Retry-After + exponential backoff w/ jitter. Added DLQ path for max attempts exceeded. Working on audit logging (payload_hash + response snippet truncation).

2025-02-25 — Marcus Lin (Security Eng): Reviewed fields proposed for outbound event. OK if company-level only. Do not log raw payload; payload_hash is fine. Response bodies should be truncated and redacted (token-like strings). Mark audit index as restricted.

2025-02-27 — Ethan Park: Opened PR redwood/pr_9833 (HubSpot integration client + batching + retries + write audit logs). Added integration test pointing at staging portal. Requesting review from Logan + David.

2025-02-28 — Logan Wright: Review: looks good. Please make retry classifier treat 409 conflicts as success only if we are certain HubSpot uses 409 for duplicate create (unclear). Otherwise keep as permanent failure with clear logging. Also ensure idempotency key is logged in audit row.

2025-03-01 — Ethan Park: Updated: 409 treated as permanent for now; added explicit metric counter for http_status=409 so we can revisit if HubSpot semantics are clarified. Audit log includes idempotency key + payload hash.

2025-03-03 — David Kim: Tested in staging portal: timeline events show correctly on company record; workflow trigger property updates are visible. Confirmed app scopes are minimal. Approved to proceed to pilot allowlist rollout.
2025-03-06 — Ethan Park: Merged PR redwood/pr_9833. Deployed behind feature flag; pilot allowlist only. Added dashboard panels for write failures + DLQ depth (ENG-2845 will wire alerts).
